courses.note: Elective: the BS requires one systems course chosen from six (architecture, compilers, operating systems, networks, databases), so no systems course is individually required, C3 is CMSC 27200, and no security course is required. Operating systems is the upper-level systems option used. Only archived syllabi from 2006 to 2014 are public; the 2025 class-archive directory is empty.

notes: The College catalog (collegecatalog.uchicago.edu, catalog.uchicago.edu) refused connections or redirected, so requirements came from the department's AY 2024-25 requirements announcement and the new-introductory-sequence FAQ. Intro sequence is CMSC 14100/14200/14300/14400; BA needs Theory A and B, BS also Theory C. Most UChicago course sites sit on Canvas.
